# Hardware atlas — entry point

AMD hardware pages for gfx950 (CDNA4, main line) and gfx942 (CDNA3, downgrade). The pack router is
`../../reference.md`. For one SKU's facts run `python3 kernel_workflow/scripts/kernel_tools/extract_sku.py --facts <SKU>`; tools
refuse a missing `--sku` and never price a missing dtype at FP16.
